_comment: WF-V6 per-subject turnaround contract (scripts/v6/README.md). Vehicle author frame: nose +z, near flank +x, y up, ground y = 0, x and z centred. Views: GPT turnaround of the concept (turnaround/README.md). No regions.json: families.table = flat colours sampled (median clusters) off the concept; families.body names the body family.

families._enclosedFg: off: no white parts (lamps are pale yellow, the grab bar / mirror brackets enclose see-through white loops)
families._body: body = the cab + refuse-body green; the rear-loader hopper (darker green) and its loading mouth are their own families, so the body span (L, x / z origin) runs from the cab nose to the refuse body's rear edge
